body: ACCEPT the D3/D5/D7 amendments in full. The plan now makes a working utterance a content-addressed resolution artifact; separates lexical correspondence, occurrence, timing availability, and processing coverage; keeps PropositionChart alignment text-local while claim envelopes carry media support; inserts a checked request/call/payload/support/cache join before AgentProposal; distinguishes request keys from realized output digests; requires provider-drift branching, strong provider identity, and permutation-invariant resolution; makes coverage a checked five-state partition; and treats SourceFrozen, DiagnosticExpansion, and CrossFittedExpansion as construction boundaries with disjointness and estimator-use laws. The fresh-call substitution, completion-order, same-key drift, deleted-line, coverage-identity, and mode-forgery courts are now explicit. C2 and D2 gates carry these requirements, so no worker may arrive before they close. This strengthens the automatic system exactly where distributed automation could otherwise manufacture reproducibility without scientific identity.
